raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Pool Qwen4-Exp PLE N-gram CPU tables across compute nodes using Mooncake EngramStore. Each node stores complete hash-head tables, while Qwen retains its computational vocabulary ownership, collectives, scaling and prefetch behavior.

This PR supports **Qwen4-Exp**, including the Qwen3.8-Flash-Next checkpoint family. It builds on the local HiCache Engram interface in #46248 and requires the remote backend in [Mooncake #5129](https://github.com/kvcache-ai/Mooncake/pull/5129). The diff against main includes the unmerged HiCache foundation.

## Modifications

- Enable `--enable-hi-engram remote` with node shard ID/count, caller configuration, Master endpoint, deployment session, lookup capacity and NIC in `--hi-engram-config`.
- Supply Qwen's head boundaries and table namespace to the shared storage adapter. Load only the node's physical head range, independently of the computational vocabulary shard.
- Preserve Qwen's global lookup IDs and computational mask. Delegate local/remote row access to EngramStore, retaining output dtype, table scaling, collectives and prefetch.
- Keep SGLang's `initialize(rows)` storage interface. Local mode calls `EngramStore.populate`; remote mode calls `EngramStore.populate_shard_and_sync` with node-owned tables and shard metadata. Mooncake encapsulates registration, discovery, RDMA setup and readiness.
- Release checkpoint CPU backing after successful publication. Mooncake shares the final CPU allocation among same-node callers.
- Keep layout selection internal to Mooncake. There are no public layout or QP options.
- Enable `NCCL_CUMEM_ENABLE=1` before distributed initialization in remote mode; reject an explicit `0` before loading weights. NCCL GIN requires cuMem.
- Append Engram fields to the ServerArgs positional field order to preserve existing positional calls.

### Head placement

For each Engram layer, node shard `s` owns whole heads in `[floor(H*s/S), floor(H*(s+1)/S))`, where `H` is the head count and `S` is the node count. This partitions contiguous head IDs by count, independently of computation ranks. With 24 heads / 2 nodes, each owns 12 heads; 10 heads / 3 nodes yields 3/3/4 heads. Different head sizes can produce unequal CPU memory usage. The adapter passes this mapping to Mooncake as `table_owners`.

Initialization must finish before CUDA Graph capture, and lookups sharing a Store workspace must be ordered.

## Accuracy Tests

Validation scripts, tests and raw experiment data are maintained in the local experiment workspace, outside this PR's file changes.

- 1,008/1,008 Local/Shard measured request pairs matched every output token: 2,016 responses and 2,064,384 generated tokens across both modes.
- Serial 16K/32K/64K checks on both nodes matched all 32 output tokens; maximum output-token logprob delta was 0 across 192 comparisons. Timed requests did not collect logprobs.
- The scoped workspace run passed 12 tests and 2 subtests; companion Mooncake checks passed 26 tests, including eager/CUDA Graph lookups beyond 2 GiB local-table offsets.
- Existing, unchanged ServerArgs positional-compatibility tests passed after appending the new fields: 3 tests and 10 subtests.
- Scoped pre-commit checks passed. Inference and storage code retain the validated implementation; the subsequent positional-field adjustment was checked with the existing compatibility tests.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

### Two-node full-model Engine benchmark

**Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-FP8**, two matching nodes, each running an independent **TP4/EP4** compute replica on **4 × NVIDIA L20Z (SM90, 80 GB)**. Only Engram storage is sharded across nodes. Local stores all Engram tables on each node; Shard uses two node owners, four callers per node and `mlx5_{local_rank}` RDMA devices (each selected port reports 200 Gb/s on both nodes).

Every 16K/32K/64K input × concurrency 8/16/32 case generates **1024 output tokens**, with **1 warmup wave + 3 measured waves** on both nodes in both modes. Greedy sampling, `ignore_eos`, deterministic inference, prefix cache disabled, fixed colocated batch submission and deterministic synthetic text-token inputs. No samples were trimmed from the final run. An earlier partial Shard attempt was stopped to add per-wave node synchronization; its results are archived and excluded.

Matched settings: context length 67,584; KV capacity 2,200,000 tokens (enough for 32 × (65,536 + 1,024)); max running requests 32; static memory fraction 0.85; chunked prefill 1,024; decode CUDA Graph batches `[1,2,4,8,16,32]`; prefill CUDA Graph 1,024. Both modes use cuMem=1; Shard started with the variable unset and exercised SGLang's new automatic enablement.

Each table cell averages the two nodes' per-case medians, **per independent model instance**. Throughput is generated output tokens divided by the complete wave duration, including prefill. Positive latency changes are slower; positive throughput changes are faster.

| Input | Concurrency | TTFT ms, Local → Shard | TPOT ms, Local → Shard | Output tok/s, Local → Shard | Throughput change |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| 16K | 8 | 4645.68 → 4762.85 | 16.24 → 16.26 | 385.19 → 383.44 | -0.45% |
| 16K | 16 | 8836.44 → 8834.88 | 22.45 → 22.51 | 519.19 → 516.00 | -0.61% |
| 16K | 32 | 16902.17 → 17018.89 | 33.69 → 33.89 | 636.81 → 633.75 | -0.48% |
| 32K | 8 | 9341.53 → 9460.17 | 19.79 → 19.90 | 276.47 → 275.16 | -0.47% |
| 32K | 16 | 17573.76 → 17791.74 | 30.25 → 30.43 | 338.88 → 336.28 | -0.77% |
| 32K | 32 | 34059.93 → 34559.38 | 49.62 → 50.03 | 386.57 → 382.24 | -1.12% |
| 64K | 8 | 19123.08 → 19319.38 | 27.45 → 27.61 | 173.31 → 172.47 | -0.49% |
| 64K | 16 | 36022.15 → 36362.66 | 46.06 → 46.34 | 197.05 → 195.75 | -0.66% |
| 64K | 32 | 69890.22 → 70577.71 | 82.67 → 83.45 | 211.97 → 210.26 | -0.81% |

Across 18 host/configuration pairs, geometric-mean Shard/Local changes were **-0.65% output throughput**, **+0.57% TPOT**, and **+1.12% TTFT**. Per-pair throughput changes ranged from -1.26% to -0.34%.

Logical Engram tables decreased from **47.68 GiB to 23.84 GiB per node (50%)**. Median measured process-tree PSS across the node/configuration observations was **64.79 GiB Local → 41.14 GiB Shard**; PSS includes runtime and other CPU allocations and is distinct from logical table size.

Measured through the **streaming Engine API**, including IPC, scheduling and detokenization; **HTTP and input tokenization are excluded**. Concurrency is offered outstanding requests, and chunked prefill overlaps decode. These rates do not isolate stage capacities. This is one process launch per mode per node with repeated waves; it does not establish independent-launch confidence intervals or results for other models/hardware.

Current logic-only source: SGLang `37856eab7d` and Mooncake `fe01041a`. Software: PyTorch 2.14.1+cu130, Triton 3.8.0, Transformers 5.19.0, CUDA toolkit 13.3, NCCL runtime 2.32.3, DeepEP `f6aa38fe06cd4a0489e7730365d4e0114970a2f3`; unchanged Mooncake Master 0.3.13 (`afe3b418`). Both hosts loaded a single matching NCCL runtime.

## Checklist

- [x] Scoped pre-commit checks
- [x] Workspace configuration and positional-compatibility checks
- [x] Full-model Qwen remote token/logprob accuracy
- [x] Two-node streaming Engine measurements (16K/32K/64K, 1K output, concurrency 8/16/32)
- [x] SGLang code style

AI assistance: Codex assisted with implementation and workspace validation. Human review remains pending.

nodes.body:
I opened a focused dependent fix against this draft branch: https://github.com/magicYang1573/sglang/pull/1

It configures the local-rank HCA before the first NCCL process group, enables cuMem for the GIN path, and lets Mooncake Engram select `rdma_device` from the same local-rank list. Focused tests cover mapping, bounds, invalid entries, and scalar/list compatibility.

Validation: targeted SGLang tests `9 passed, 37 deselected`; TP=4 native smoke passed; full Qwen3.8 remote Engram load, graph capture, and inference passed on one 8x H20 host through both endpoints; 6/6 stable first-token comparisons were token-exact (max logprob delta `7.08e-4`, `atol=1e-3`). Runtime validation used predecessor head `c174b8c3`; the patch is rebased to current draft head `5556617b`, whose relevant initialization/device-selection logic was unchanged.

+"""HiCache storage for immutable Engram tables."""
+
+import json
+
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.hicache_storage import HiCacheEngramStorage
+
+
+def _parse_config(config: str | None, mode: str = "local") -> dict:
+    """Parse and validate the HiCache Engram storage options."""
+    try:
+        options = {} if config is None else json.loads(config)
+    except (TypeError, json.JSONDecodeError) as exc:
+        raise ValueError("--hi-engram-config must be a JSON object") from exc
+    if not isinstance(options, dict):
+        raise ValueError("--hi-engram-config must be a JSON object")
+    allowed = {"local_dir"}
+    if mode == "remote":
+        allowed |= {
+            "shard_id",
+            "num_shards",
+            "master_addr",
+            "session_id",
+            "caller_id",
+            "max_lookup_rows",
+            "rdma_device",
+            "timeout",
+            "num_callers",
+        }
+    unknown = options.keys() - allowed
+    if unknown:
+        raise ValueError(f"Unknown --hi-engram-config options: {sorted(unknown)}")
+    options.setdefault("local_dir", "/dev/shm/sglang-engram")
+    if not isinstance(options["local_dir"], str) or not options["local_dir"]:
+        raise ValueError("--hi-engram-config local_dir must be a nonempty string")
+    if mode == "remote":
+        required = {
+            "shard_id",
+            "num_shards",
+            "master_addr",
+            "session_id",
+            "max_lookup_rows",
+        }
+        if required - options.keys():
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"Missing remote Engram options: {sorted(required - options.keys())}"
+            )
+        for name in ("shard_id", "num_shards", "max_lookup_rows"):
+            if type(options[name]) is not int:
+                raise ValueError(f"Remote Engram {name} must be an integer")
+        if (
+            not 0 <= options["shard_id"] < options["num_shards"]
+            or options["max_lookup_rows"] < 1
+        ):
+            raise ValueError("Invalid node shard ID/count or lookup capacity")
+        for name in ("master_addr", "session_id"):
+            if not isinstance(options[name], str) or not options[name]:
+                raise ValueError(f"Remote Engram {name} must be a nonempty string")
+    return options
+
+
+def create_storage(
+    mode: str, config: str | None = None, *, head_bounds=None, namespace=None
+) -> HiCacheEngramStorage:
+    """Create row storage without requiring a KV cache or host KV pool."""
+    if mode in ("local", "remote"):
+        from sglang.srt.mem_cache.storage.mooncake_engram import (
+            MooncakeEngramStorage,
+        )
+
+        options = _parse_config(config, mode)
+        if mode == "remote":
+            local_dir = options.pop("local_dir")
+            return MooncakeEngramStorage(
+                local_dir=local_dir,
+                remote=options,
+                head_bounds=head_bounds,
+                namespace=namespace,
+            )
+        return MooncakeEngramStorage(**options)
+    raise ValueError(f"Unknown Engram storage mode: {mode!r}")

+"""Embedding adapters preserving native checkpoint names and TP partitioning."""
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.layers.vocab_parallel_embedding import (
+    UnquantizedEmbeddingMethod,
+    VocabParallelEmbedding,
+    attn_tp_all_reduce,
+    get_attn_tp_context,
+    get_masked_input_and_mask,
+    is_allocation_symmetric,
+    tensor_model_parallel_all_reduce,
+    use_symmetric_memory,
+)
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.engram import create_storage
+from sglang.srt.runtime_context import get_memory, get_parallel
+
+
+class HiCacheVocabParallelEmbedding(VocabParallelEmbedding):
+    """Preserve embedding weight loading and TP semantics over byte-row storage."""
+
+    def __init__(self, *args, **kwargs):
+        config = get_memory()
+        bounds = kwargs.pop("engram_head_bounds", None)
+        namespace = kwargs.pop("engram_namespace", None)
+        rows = create_storage(
+            config.enable_hi_engram,
+            config.hi_engram_config,
+            head_bounds=bounds,
+            namespace=namespace,
+        )
+        with torch.device("meta" if config.enable_hi_engram == "remote" else "cpu"):
+            super().__init__(*args, **kwargs)
+        if not isinstance(self.quant_method, UnquantizedEmbeddingMethod):
+            raise ValueError("HiCache Engram requires an uncompressed row tensor")
+        # This method has no post-load work. Avoid the loader staging the CPU
+        # table to CUDA for quantization postprocessing.
+        self.quant_method = None
+        self._rows = rows
+        self._rows_initialized = False
+        if config.enable_hi_engram == "remote":
+            old_weight = self.weight
+            self.weight = torch.nn.Parameter(
+                torch.empty(
+                    (rows.row_end - rows.row_start, self.embedding_dim),
+                    dtype=old_weight.dtype,
+                    device="cpu",
+                ),
+                requires_grad=False,
+            )
+            self.weight.__dict__.update(old_weight.__dict__)
+            self.storage_row_start, self.storage_row_end = rows.row_start, rows.row_end
+
+    def weight_loader(self, param, loaded_weight):
+        if self._rows.remote is not None:
+            param.data.copy_(
+                loaded_weight[self.storage_row_start : self.storage_row_end]
+            )
+            return
+        return super().weight_loader(param, loaded_weight)
+
+    def _embed_local_shard(self, input_):
+        if not self._rows_initialized:
+            self._rows.initialize(self.weight.detach().view(torch.uint8))
+            # Storage owns the rows now; keep only the parameter's dtype/metadata.
+            self.weight.data = self.weight.new_empty(0)
+            self._rows_initialized = True
+        if self._rows.remote is not None:
+            # Keep computational TP ownership exactly as before. Only the
+            # physical owner of each selected row is resolved by EngramStore.
+            mask = (input_ < self.shard_indices.org_vocab_start_index) | (
+                input_ >= self.shard_indices.org_vocab_end_index
+            )
+            ids = input_.masked_fill(mask, -1)
+            with use_symmetric_memory(
+                get_parallel().tp_group, disabled=not is_allocation_symmetric()
+            ):
+                out = self._rows.lookup(ids).view(self.weight.dtype)
+                return (
+                    out.to(self.output_dtype) if self.output_dtype is not None else out
+                )
+        if self.tp_size > 1:
+            ids, mask = get_masked_input_and_mask(
+                input_,
+                self.shard_indices.org_vocab_start_index,
+                self.shard_indices.org_vocab_end_index,
+                self.shard_indices.num_org_vocab_padding,
+                self.shard_indices.added_vocab_start_index,

+"""HiCache row storage backed by Mooncake EngramStore."""
+
+import contextlib
+import logging
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.hicache_storage import HiCacheEngramStorage
+
+logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+
+
+class MooncakeEngramStorage(HiCacheEngramStorage):
+    def __init__(
+        self, *, local_dir: str, remote=None, head_bounds=None, namespace=None
+    ):
+        self._local_dir = local_dir
+        self._store = None
+        self.remote = remote
+        self._namespace = namespace
+        if remote is not None:
+            if (
+                not namespace
+                or not head_bounds
+                or head_bounds[0] != 0
+                or any(a >= b for a, b in zip(head_bounds, head_bounds[1:]))
+            ):
+                raise ValueError(
+                    "Remote Engram requires a named table and increasing head boundaries"
+                )
+            heads = len(head_bounds) - 1
+            shards, shard = remote["num_shards"], remote["shard_id"]
+            if shards > heads:
+                raise ValueError("More node shards than Engram hash heads")
+            self._bounds = tuple(head_bounds)
+            self._head_begin, self._head_end = (
+                heads * shard // shards,
+                heads * (shard + 1) // shards,
+            )
+            self.row_start, self.row_end = (
+                head_bounds[self._head_begin],
+                head_bounds[self._head_end],
+            )
+            self._names = tuple(f"head{i}" for i in range(heads))
+            self._owners = {
+                name: ((i + 1) * shards - 1) // heads
+                for i, name in enumerate(self._names)
+            }
+
+    def initialize(self, rows: torch.Tensor) -> None:
+        from mooncake.engram import EngramStore
+
+        if self._store is not None:
+            raise RuntimeError("Engram tables are immutable; already initialized")
+        if torch.cuda.is_initialized() and torch.cuda.is_current_stream_capturing():
+            raise RuntimeError("Warm up Engram tables before CUDA graph capture")
+        if rows.device.type != "cpu" or rows.dtype != torch.uint8 or rows.ndim != 2:
+            raise ValueError("Engram initialization requires a CPU byte matrix")
+        row_bytes = rows.shape[1]
+        if self.remote is not None:
+            return self._initialize_remote(rows, row_bytes)
+        store = EngramStore(
+            tables={"rows": {"num_rows": rows.shape[0], "row_bytes": row_bytes}},
+            namespace="sglang-v1",
+            local_dir=self._local_dir,
+            persistent=False,
+        )
+        try:
+            store.populate("rows", rows.detach().contiguous().numpy())
+        except BaseException:
+            store.close()
+            raise
+        self._row_bytes = row_bytes
+        self._store = store
+        logger.info("Mooncake Engram: published %s rows of %s bytes", *rows.shape)
+
+    def _initialize_remote(self, rows, row_bytes):
+        from mooncake.engram import EngramStore
+
+        if rows.shape[0] != self.row_end - self.row_start:
+            raise ValueError("Loaded rows must match this node's storage heads")
+        tables = {
+            name: {
+                "num_rows": self._bounds[i + 1] - self._bounds[i],
+                "row_bytes": row_bytes,
+            }
+            for i, name in enumerate(self._names)
+        }
+        local = {
+            self._names[i]: rows[
+                self._bounds[i] - self.row_start : self._bounds[i + 1] - self.row_start
+            ]
+            for i in range(self._head_begin, self._head_end)
+        }
+        store = EngramStore(
+            tables=tables,
+            namespace=self._namespace,
+            local_dir=self._local_dir,
+            persistent=False,
+        )
+        options = dict(self.remote)
+        options.setdefault("caller_id", torch.cuda.current_device())
+        if "rdma_device" in options:
+            options["rdma_device"] = options["rdma_device"].format(
+                local_rank=torch.cuda.current_device()
+            )
+        try:
+            store.populate_shard_and_sync(local, table_owners=self._owners, **options)
+        except BaseException:
+            store.close()
+            raise
+        self._store, self._row_bytes = store, row_bytes
+        logger.info(
+            "Mooncake Engram %s: node shard %s/%s, stored heads [%s,%s)",
+            self._namespace,
+            options["shard_id"],
+            options["num_shards"],
+            self._head_begin,
+            self._head_end,
+        )
+
+    def lookup(self, ids: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        if self._store is None:
+            raise RuntimeError("Initialize Engram storage before lookup")
+        if ids.dtype not in (torch.int32, torch.int64):
+            raise TypeError("Engram row IDs must be int32 or int64")
+        if self.remote is not None:
+            if not ids.is_cuda or ids.numel() % len(self._names):
+                raise ValueError(
+                    "Remote lookup requires CUDA token-major hash-head IDs"
+                )
+            indices = ids.reshape(-1, len(self._names))
+            output = torch.zeros(
+                (*indices.shape, self._row_bytes), dtype=torch.uint8, device=ids.device
+            )
+            self._store.lookup(
+                self._names,
+                indices,
+                output,
+                offsets=self._bounds[:-1],
+                stream=torch.cuda.current_stream(ids.device).cuda_stream,
+            )
+            return output.view(*ids.shape, self._row_bytes)
+        indices = ids.reshape(-1, 1).contiguous()
+        output = torch.zeros(
+            (indices.shape[0], 1, self._row_bytes),
+            dtype=torch.uint8,
+            device=ids.device,
+        )
+        # Empty idle batches must not launch a zero-sized CUDA grid.
+        if indices.numel():
+            if ids.is_cuda:
+                self._store.lookup(
+                    ["rows"],
+                    indices,
+                    output,
+                    stream=torch.cuda.current_stream(ids.device).cuda_stream,
+                )
+            else:
+                self._store.lookup(["rows"], indices.numpy(), output.numpy())
+        return output.view(*ids.shape, self._row_bytes)
+
+    def close(self) -> None:
+        if self._store is not None:
+            self._store.close()
+            self._store = None
+
+    def __del__(self):
+        with contextlib.suppress(Exception):
+            self.close()

issue_comments.body:
I opened a focused dependent fix against this draft branch: https://github.com/magicYang1573/sglang/pull/1

It configures the local-rank HCA before the first NCCL process group, enables cuMem for the GIN path, and lets Mooncake Engram select `rdma_device` from the same local-rank list. Focused tests cover mapping, bounds, invalid entries, and scalar/list compatibility.

Validation: targeted SGLang tests `9 passed, 37 deselected`; TP=4 native smoke passed; full Qwen3.8 remote Engram load, graph capture, and inference passed on one 8x H20 host through both endpoints; 6/6 stable first-token comparisons were token-exact (max logprob delta `7.08e-4`, `atol=1e-3`). Runtime validation used predecessor head `c174b8c3`; the patch is rebased to current draft head `5556617b`, whose relevant initialization/device-selection logic was unchanged.
